thread:
Lina Gomez: Quick spot-check before I push yesterday's copy tweaks to the autoscale panel. Two things: min/max nomenclature and consistent "On-demand" phrasing for burst. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/autoscale-panel
Arjun Rao: Re: min/max 14 I hit a bug where screen readers only read 'Min' and 'Max' with no context. Can we make labels 'Min GPUs' / 'Max GPUs' and add a visually-hidden unit?
Priya Shah: +1. Also the stepper control currently increments by 0.5 in the design token but UI enforces whole GPUs. Either change step to 1 or show fractional as 'vCPU-equivalent' which is confusing. I'd rather keep whole numbers and validate input.
Oliver (Design): Good catches. I'll update artboards to show explicit 'Min GPUs' and 'Max GPUs' and change stepper to step=1. I'll darken the stepper focus ring to meet contrast.
eng-bot: deploy-preview: autoscale-panel/feature/minmax-a11y available at https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/changes/3421 (expires in 48h)
Lina Gomez: For the burst wording - team prefers 'On-demand burst' instead of just 'Burst' to avoid ambiguity with reserved 'burst' quotas. Also propose tooltip: 'Temporarily scales pool capacity. Billed per second.' Thoughts?
Priya Shah: Love the tooltip. Small copy variant: 'Temporarily increases pool GPUs. Billed per second.' Shorter and explicit about GPUs.
Arjun Rao: accessibility-bot suggested aria-live announcements when burst activates (so screen reader users know capacity changed). That seems important for state changes.
accessibility-bot: Recommendation: add aria-live="polite" region announcing 'Pool capacity increased by N GPUs for X minutes' and ensure the burst toggle has aria-pressed and an accessible name. Also keyboard activation must be space/enter.
Oliver (Design): I'll add a tiny inline confirmation toast in the mock (non-modal) and ensure the toast is announced by aria-live. Also changing burst chip text to 'On-demand burst' and the API alias note will be added to docs.
Lina Gomez: Quick acceptance criteria for merge: 1) Labels updated to 'Min GPUs'/'Max GPUs' 2) Stepper step=1 and validation prevents decimals 3) Burst label changed to 'On-demand burst' with tooltip copy 'Temporarily increases pool GPUs. Billed per second.' 4) aria-live toast on activation 5) Dev snippet for slider/stepper a11y shared in PR. Can someone volunteer to pair for the dev snippet?
Arjun Rao: I can pair with design on the snippet tomorrow morning.
Priya Shah: I'll review the copy PR once Lina pushes.
Lina Gomez: Thanks all, I'll open the PR and include Figma links and the a11y checklist. :raised_hands:
